0022600030.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, 15th in the East and on a four-game losing streak) host the Toronto Raptors (4-4, 5th in the East and coming off a loss) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup, the Bucks' ninth game of the 2026-27 season. Kam Jones is out for Milwaukee with an ankle injury, while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and the Bucks are 1-3 at home and 0-4 on the road compared with Toronto's 2-1 home and 2-3 road records. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-3, including a 122-94 defeat to the Raptors in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
